pull_quotes.quote: The old system, where the investor handed over a cheque and hoped the refund came on time, is gone.
pull_quotes.rationale: Highlights the key benefit of ASBA in a memorable, contrastive sentence.

sidebars.body_markdown: Using a third-party bank account or UPI ID leads to automatic rejection. Even if the PAN is correct, the application is invalid. The registrar cross-checks the PAN in the demat account with the bank account PAN. A mismatch also results in rejection. Always apply from your own account, with your own PAN, using your own UPI ID.
sidebars.rationale: Reinforces the hard rule with concrete examples, reducing applicant errors.
sidebars.title: Common rejection scenarios
